description: This file contains a Kotlin class 'ProductAdapter' that extends RecyclerView.Adapter to display a list of products in an online shopping platform. It manages product items, handles pagination with a loading footer, supports updating favorite status, and optimizes item updates with DiffUtil.

classes.name: ProductAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of Product items with support for footers and item updates.

classes.name: ProductVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for product item views, manages binding product data to views.

classes.name: LoadingVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for the loading footer view.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Replaces the entire list of products and sets the repository.

methods.name: submitWithFooter
methods.description: Replaces list and toggles loading footer visibility.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds more products to the existing list, used for pagination.

methods.name: setLoadingFooterVisible
methods.description: Shows or hides the loading footer.

methods.name: submitInternal
methods.description: Performs the internal list update and diff calculation.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for items, used for RecyclerView optimizations.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Determines the view type for each position, either product or loading.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates appropriate ViewHolder for product or loading view.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to ViewHolders for display.

methods.name: notifyFavoriteChanged
methods.description: Notifies the adapter that a product's favorite status has changed, updating only that row.
